where:

  T2 (backtick-name) = W_BACKTICK_NAME × |parts ∩ signals['backtick_idents']|

  T2b (backtick-body) = W_BACKTICK_BODY × |idents ∩ signals['backtick_idents']|

  T5 (exception match) = W_EXCEPTION_MATCH × |signals['exception_types'] ∩ exc_types| if signals['exception_types'] ≠ ∅ and exc_types ≠ ∅, else 0.

  T6 (body words) = (|body_words ∩ signals['all_words']| / max(body_lines, 1)^0.5) × W_BODY_WORDS.
